title: Use of materials.
officialText:
Except as set forth in sections 28-113.2.1 through 28-113.2.6 materials specifically prescribed by this code or department rules may be used as prescribed without the prior approval of the commissioner.

(Am. L.L. 2021/126, 11/7/2021, eff. 11/7/2022)
